answer: Farming becomes a pulse bet on surviving 71 epochs of grading, and every meadow settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 71 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
